assets.purpose: Shared end of clip 1 and start of clip 2.

assets.purpose: Shared end of clip 2 and start of clip 3.

Using the established fictional presenter, show a rooftop at dusk, notebook closed against her chest, natural warm smile. Medium shot, amber practical light and cool distant skyline. Keep exact clothing and identity. No text or logos.

clips.purpose: Apresentar a ideia e preparar uma passagem por objeto.

shots.intent: Introduce the planning problem through a concrete object.
shots.action: The presenter opens the notebook with her left hand while her right hand supports it. She points to a blank page, then looks back at the lens.
shots.composition: Eye-level medium shot; keep the face, both hands and notebook visible.
shots.camera: A slow short push toward the presenter; stop before either hand is cropped.
shots.performance: Conversational curiosity, a small eyebrow raise on the question; no exaggerated acting.
shots.lighting: Soft window key from camera left; neutral skin and a gentle amber practical in the background.

shots.intent: Finish the thought and motivate the move to the station.
shots.action: She closes the notebook, keeps it in her right hand, and moves it from left to right across the lens. It fills the frame at the end.
shots.composition: Maintain the same screen direction and keep the notebook edge in focus during the approach.
shots.camera: Return to a stable eye-level medium shot before the object reaches the lens.
shots.performance: Calm confidence; finish the sentence before the notebook covers her mouth.
shots.lighting: Keep exposure steady as the ochre cover fills the frame.

dialogue.text: Uma boa viagem começa antes de sair. Primeiro, escolha o que você quer viver.
dialogue.delivery: Brazilian Portuguese, natural conversational pace, preserve one voice across all clips.

audio.voice_direction: Keep the same close, natural presenter voice in every clip.
audio.music: No music in the generated clip; the final edit may use one continuous track.
audio.sfx: Only quiet sounds caused by the visible hand and notebook actions.

post.brief: Render the exact editorial title: "ANTES DE SAIR".
post.trigger: Align to the corresponding spoken phrase after inspecting the returned audio.

shots.intent: Complete the message with a calm, usable ending.

shots.performance: Warm, understated delivery and a short breath after the final phrase.
shots.lighting: Keep the same dusk balance and skin tone through the last frame.
